sections.title: 12.3 Prompt Engineering Best Practices
sections.body:
### The Anatomy of a Great Prompt

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    PROMPT STRUCTURE                    │
│                                                       │
│  [1] ROLE       "You are an expert data scientist..." │
│  [2] CONTEXT    "We have sales data from 2023-2024..." │
│  [3] TASK       "Analyze this data and identify..."   │
│  [4] FORMAT     "Respond in a table with columns..."  │
│  [5] EXAMPLES   "For example: Input: X → Output: Y"  │
│  [6] CONSTRAINTS "Keep response under 200 words..."  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Prompt Techniques

**Zero-Shot (No examples):**
```
"Classify this customer review as Positive, Negative, or Neutral:
'The product arrived late but works great!'"
```

**Few-Shot (With examples):**
```
"Classify these reviews:
Review: 'Amazing product!' → Positive
Review: 'Terrible, broke after 1 day' → Negative  
Review: 'It's okay, nothing special' → Neutral

Now classify: 'The product arrived late but works great!'"
```

**Chain of Thought (Step-by-step reasoning):**
```
"Solve this problem step by step, showing your reasoning at each step:
A store has 150 apples. They sell 40% on Monday and 25% of remainder 
on Tuesday. How many are left?"
```

# 📚 BONUS: Quick Reference Cheat Sheet

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    QUICK REFERENCE CHEAT SHEET                   │
├────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│    CONCEPT         │              REMEMBER IT AS                  │
├────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Generative AI     │  AI that CREATES new content                 │
│  LLM               │  AI trained to predict next word             │
│  Transformer       │  Neural net with ATTENTION mechanism         │
│  Tokenization      │  Breaking text into numbered pieces          │
│  Embeddings        │  Numbers that capture MEANING of text        │
│  Context Window    │  LLM's working memory / whiteboard size      │
│  Temperature       │  0=Predictable ←→ 2=Creative                 │
│  Top-P             │  Limits word choices to top P% probability   │
│  Streaming         │  Token-by-token response (word by word)      │
│  Hallucination     │  LLM confidently makes up false info         │
│  Function Calling  │  LLM DECIDES which tool to call              │
│  RAG               │  Give LLM YOUR documents to answer from      │
│  Fine-tuning       │  Teach LLM new behavior/style/domain         │
│  AI Agent          │  LLM + Tools + Loop = Autonomous AI          │
├────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  TEMPERATURE GUIDE │  Code/SQL: 0.0 │ Chat: 0.7 │ Creative: 1.5  │
│  TOKEN RULE        │  ~1 token = ~4 chars = ~¾ word               │
│  CONTEXT RULE      │  1000 words ≈ 750 tokens                     │
├────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  LLM GOOD AT       │  Writing, coding, explaining, translating    │
│  LLM BAD AT        │  Real-time data, math, memory, facts         │
└────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

# 🗺️ Suggested Teaching Schedule

| Session | Duration | Topics |
|---------|----------|--------|
| **Session 1** | 2 hours | What is AI? GenAI? LLMs? Applications |
| **Session 2** | 2 hours | Transformer Architecture + Attention |
| **Session 3** | 1.5 hours | Tokenization + Embeddings |
| **Session 4** | 1.5 hours | Context Window + Temperature + Top-P |
| **Session 5** | 1 hour | Streaming + LLM Capabilities & Limitations |
| **Session 6** | 2 hours | Function Calling + Tools + Agents |
| **Session 7** | 1.5 hours | How to Approach GenAI Problems + Hands-on |

**💡 Teaching Tips:**
1. Start every session with a **real-world analogy** before any technical content
2. Use **live demos** on ChatGPT to show concepts immediately
3. Give **hands-on exercises** — let team members write prompts
4. Create a **Q&A time** at the end of each session
5. Build a **simple chatbot together** as the final project

This is your complete, structured training material! Every concept is explained with:
- ✅ Simple definitions anyone can understand
- ✅ Real-world analogies
- ✅ Visual diagrams
- ✅ Code examples where relevant
- ✅ Practical "when to use what" guidance

Your team will go from zero to fully understanding the GenAI ecosystem after these sessions! 🚀
